verdict.rationale: Atlas is an incorporation service, not a contract-lifecycle tool. Its only overlap with this story is a Documents tab in the Atlas Dashboard, where you can view executed incorporation documents. You can also create, send and track SAFEs from the Dashboard. Neither is evidenced as a general searchable contract repository. Missing for 10: search across contracts, key-term/metadata extraction, storage of arbitrary executed third-party contracts, and any independent corroboration of document-repository use.
